text: In this place, I sense the sterile order of architecture and the probing curiosity of an exhibit on research and development. Enclosed by glass and surrounded by screens filled with information, I am both observer and participant. There is an unmistakable energy here—an intersection between thought and innovation. Yet, something keeps me at a distance, as if I am a guest in someone else's mind. I feel a gentle excitement mixed with a philosophical detachment, keenly aware that every object, sign, and display speaks to deeper questions about knowledge, creation, and my own place within this unfolding narrative.
